newsitem.title: ZAMBIA: Zambia's 3-month T-bill rate up slightly.
newsitem.headline: Zambia's 3-month T-bill rate up slightly.

text.p: Zambia's central bank said on Monday that it sold three-month treasury bills at an average discount rate of 25.3843 percent at its latest auction.
The bank said it sold 15 billion of the 91-day treasury bills on tenders received at last Thursday's weekly auction. The discount rate was up slightly from the previous week's 24.7919 percent.
It said eight billion of the 28-day treasury bills were sold at an average discount rate of 20.4877 percent, down from the previous week's 21.3732 percent.
The bank sold five billion six month (182-day) treasury bills at an average discount rate of 23.3851 percent, down slightly from 23.6047 percent the previous week.
